description.value:
As an action, you can touch a creature (including yourself) to grant one of the following benefits, your choice:

  • For the next 10 minutes, the creature may roll a d3 on any attack roll or ability check and add the result to the d20 roll; once granted, that creature can't gain this benefit again until it finishes a short or long rest.
  • Roll a d4; the creature regains that many tech points. Once granted, that creature can't gain this benefit again until it finishes a long rest.

You can use this feature three times, gaining an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level, and regain all uses on finishing a long rest.
